_comment_solanaRpcFallbackUrls: Second and further TRUSTED same-cluster endpoints. A single endpoint is what took the catalog to HTTP 503 when one key hit its quota (F-235/F-238); worse here, because boot identity turns any chain error into log.Fatalf under Restart=on-failure. Must not duplicate solanaRpcUrl.
_comment_estateProfile: The owner-signed EstateProfileV1 of this estate and its reviewed profileSha256 (melusina-store-sidecar estate-profile-review). The installer-release gate admits an InstallerReleaseEntry only when its publisher key is in the profile's releaseTrust and its custodian is the profile's core vault; programId and masterNftMint must be the profile's.
